mapper.select: SELECT *, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow f WHERE f.followed_member_id = m.member_id ) AS followerNum FROM member m WHERE m.member_id = #{member_id} AND m.member_delete_yn = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_id, member_name, member_nickname, member_email, member_created_date, member_delete_yn, member_last_login, member_last_logout) VALUES (#{member_id}, #{member_name}, #{member_nickname}, #{member_email}, #{member_created_date}, #{member_delete_yn}, #{member_last_login}, #{member_last_logout})
